messages:
becky: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a PR to simplify the onboarding quickstart flow (hello starter app + first deploy). Goal is: 1) reduce auth friction, 2) make the CLI steps copy-pastable, 3) fix two broken links in the deploy section. I'll link the PR in a sec.

sam: thank you! can you call out which links are broken? i hit one yesterday while following the guide.

becky: yep — the OSS model link and the telemetry opt-in link. i'll update both. also migrating the Node SDK snippet from v2->v3 API surface (small rename).

raj: for the SDK snippet migration, can we keep the minimal example but show both curl and JS? some folks still start with curl.

becky: good call. plan is: top of quickstart keep curl minimal, then JS snippet below. curl will look like:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-qa","prompt":"Hi"}'
```

and JS will use the new sdk import:

```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-qa', prompt: 'Hi' });
console.log(res.text);
```

maria: small nit — please add the auth env var example (export line) and a note about token scopes for new accounts. newbies always miss that step.

becky: added. also adding a short troubleshooting subsection for CORS on first deploy (most common snag). i'll flag the PR for docs-review when ready.

sam: :eyes: can you also add a one-liner about pinning model versions in Dedicated? avoids surprise changes.

becky: done, added a "pin your model" note with a config snippet and link to the rollout docs.

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — title: "Warmstart quickstart: simplify auth + migrate SDK snippets + link fixes" (be c/o becky)

raj: reviewing now. will leave inline comments for the JS async/await bit and a tiny wording tweak under "first deploy".

maria: i'll check the telemetry opt-in phrasing — want to ensure it's explicit about data sent and default state.

becky: great, thanks all. aiming to merge by EOD so the microsite can pick up changes before next deploy. ping here if you find anything blocking. :thumbsup:
